name: Leshy, Leaf
body:
LEAF LESHY
CR 5

This little plant person is clad in a winglike leaf cloak and pine cone armor, wielding a twig as a makeshift spear. Its wears a peaceful smile at all times.

XP 1,600
NG Small plant (leshy)
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 14, flat-footed 14 (+2 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +1 size)
hp 45 (7d8+14)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +6
Immune electricity, plant traits, sonic

OFFENSE

Speed 20 ft., climb 10 ft., fly 10 ft. (clumsy); glide
Melee shortspear +4 (1d4–2/19–20)
Ranged seedpods +8 touch (1d6 plus deafen)
Druid Spells Prepared (CL 7th; concentration +9)

4th—ball lightning (DC 16)
3rd—call lightning (DC 15), greater magic fang
2nd—barkskin, bull’s strength, heat metal (DC 14), warp wood (DC 14)
1st—entangle (DC 13), goodberry, longstrider, obscuring mist, speak with animals
0th (at will)—create water, flare (DC 12), guidance, know direction

Special Attacks verdant channel 3/day (4d6)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 7th; concentration +8)

At-Will—tree shape (small bush only)
Constant—pass without trace, speak with plants

STATISTICS

Str 6, Dex 15, Con 12, Int 7, Wis 14, Cha 13
Base Atk +5; CMB +2; CMD 15
Feats Dodge, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Toughness
Skills Fly +1, Stealth +6 (+10 in forests), Survival +2 (+6 in forests); Racial Modifiers +4 Stealth and Survival in forests
Languages Common, Druidic, Sylvan
SQ glide

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Glide (Ex)

A leaf leshy cannot use its fly speed to hover. When flying, a leaf leshy must end its movement at least 5 feet lower in elevation than it started.

Seedpods (Ex)

A seedpod has a range increment of 20 feet and detonates on contact to deal 1d6 point of bludgeoning damage (not modified by Strength). Anyone struck by a seedpod must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save or be deafened for 1 round. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Verdant Channel (Ex)

A leaf leshy can channel verdant energy to a range of 30 feet. This acts as channel positive energy, but it can only heal plant creatures and deals no damage to undead.
